# FG-DB-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_stale_worker_is_fenced_and_the_newer_result_is_kept` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックグラウンドの処理をやり直しています。
- en: A background task is being retried.
- id: Tugas latar belakang sedang dicoba ulang.

## 原因 (cause)

A job's lease ended before its result was recorded. reason=lease_expired: the reaper found a running job past lease_until (= claim + timeout_ms + 30 s: the worker crashed, was stopped, or its run was cancelled) and queued it again after the backoff; fenced: a worker tried to record a result for a lease it no longer holds (reaped and re-claimed by another worker or attempt) — the result was discarded and the newer one kept; execution_timeout: the handler ran longer than the job's timeout_ms and was aborted (retried after the backoff); reaper_behind (forge doctor jobs.expired_leases): a lease expired more than 60 s ago and nobody reaped it — no forge worker runs its reaper. Jobs run at least once: a handler may run again after this.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`, `job_id`, `kind`, `worker_id` (the lease holder: `w<pid>-<random>` of a forge worker process), `attempt`, and for execution_timeout `timeout_ms`; its request_id is the job's origin_request_id. Look for the worker's own log around the time (a restart, `forge.worker.stopped`, a crash) and for the same job_id's earlier lines. Many lease_expired lines after a worker restart are expected (one per job that was running). Repeated execution_timeout for one kind means its timeout is too short or the handler hangs on an external call.

## 対処 (fix)

Usually none: the job is retried. Repeated for one kind: fix the handler (an unbounded wait) or raise that kind's timeout in code; reaper_behind: start `forge worker`. A job that keeps expiring ends as FG-DB-0006 when its attempts are used up.
